semanticMeaning: Deterministic creature perception/state policy that converts bounded player/environment observations into behavior state plus consumer-facing gameplay intents. It does not own pathfinding, cover geometry, animation blending, shader implementation, audio selection, engine integration, or telemetry transport.

states.name: UNAWARE
states.meaning: No sustained perceived threat; baseline idle/forage semantics may be mapped downstream.

states.name: ORIENT
states.meaning: A meaningful stimulus has been acquired; orient/track while threat is below freeze/evade consequence.

states.name: FREEZE
states.meaning: Threat is material but no accepted concealment/escape consequence is currently available; suppress locomotion while evaluating.

states.name: CONCEAL
states.meaning: Use or maintain a declared concealment opportunity and raise concealment/camouflage intent without claiming invisibility.

states.name: EVADE
states.meaning: Threat is high and a downstream-valid escape traversal is available; request escape movement away from threat.

states.name: RECOVER
states.meaning: Threat has decayed after a defensive state; reassess before returning to UNAWARE.

inputs.player_distance_m: non-negative meters from caller-declared threat source
inputs.line_of_sight: bounded boolean visibility observation; F13 does not infer through occluders
inputs.observation_pressure: 0..1 explicit player observation/approach pressure supplied by the integrated player/core-loop contract
inputs.nonvisual_stimulus: optional 0..1 nonvisual perception input; exact source meaning remains consumer/producer-bound
inputs.concealment_available: temporary adapter boolean meaning that F14 can supply at least one legal concealment affordance; NOT the authoritative F14 representation
inputs.concealment_quality: temporary 0..1 adapter field reserved for F14-selected affordance quality; current policy does not reinterpret geometry
inputs.escape_available: temporary adapter boolean meaning F14 can satisfy an escape traversal request; NOT pathfinding ownership

outputs.state_name: stable state vocabulary for F09/F12/F16/F17/F22 consumers
outputs.transition_reason_name: mechanical reason for the latest state change
outputs.threat: 0..1 deterministic threat pressure used by this policy
outputs.nav_intent.action: NONE | FACE_THREAT | HOLD_POSITION | SEEK_OR_MAINTAIN_CONCEALMENT | EVADE_FROM_THREAT | HOLD_OR_SLOW_REPOSITION
outputs.nav_intent.target_semantics: semantic request only; F14 owns legal path/affordance realization
outputs.orientation_intent: semantic orientation request consumed by downstream motion/integration
outputs.camouflage_drive: 0..1 concealment intent for F12; shader/material mapping remains F12 ownership

preconditions: Caller values must be bound to the exact integrated condition rather than hidden omniscient state.
F14 must eventually replace the temporary concealment_available/concealment_quality/escape_available adapter expectations with its exact authoritative representation or an explicit adapter.
A01/A02/A03 may change thresholds or product meaning; fixture defaults are not Human-balanced claims.
consumerVisibleFailureModes: EVADE emitted when no legal escape traversal exists
private F13 cover semantics diverge from F14
state changes without downstream gameplay consequence
consumer mappings drift from the state vocabulary
same input sequence produces non-replayable decision traces
validationOracle: Under deterministic fixtures, player/environment perception causes reproducible ORIENT/FREEZE/CONCEAL/EVADE/RECOVER consequences; EVADE is gated on downstream escape availability; no private path or cover geometry is invented; same input sequence replays identically.
compatibility: DRAFT_COMPATIBLE_FOR_CONSUMER_IMPLEMENTATION; upstream semantic and F14 representation bindings still required before integrated standing can exceed PROTOTYPED_LOCAL.
